function.arguments: {"index": 3, "status": "acted", "resolution": "The treatment arm distribution is unbalanced by sex: females are underrepresented in the treatment arm (160 vs 276 males). This creates a confounding bias: since the treatment arm may affect response, comparing raw response rates by sex would conflate the treatment effect with sex. To properly estimate the sex effect, we must adjust for treatment arm. I used a weighted average of within-arm differences (F - M), weighted by arm size, to compute the adjusted difference in response rates. This method removes the confounding bias and provides a valid estimate of the sex effect on response."}
